title: The Interplay Between Electromagnetic Fields and Baryon Stopping in a Hydrodynamic Model for Charged Flow
summary: Charge-dependent directed flow provides a sensitive probe of early electromagnetic fields and baryon stopping in relativistic heavy-ion collisions. Recent STAR measurements show a centrality-dependent sign change in the directed flow splitting (the difference between the directed flow of protons and antiprotons), indicating that electromagnetic effects alone are not sufficient to describe this observable and that the baryon stopping $-$ in particular the component of the stopped proton distribution that is odd in rapidity and odd under reflection in the impact parameter direction $-$ must…
